description_en: Queries the top 10 rule IDs that have triggered mitigation policies the most times
description_zh: 查看触发防护规则次数最多的前10个规则ID
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-rule-hits-top-rule-id --start-timestamp 1665331200 --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRuleHitsTopRuleId

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询的开始时间，单位：秒
parameters.name: start_timestamp

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Unit: seconds. If you do not specify this parameter, the current time is used
parameters.help_zh: 查询的结束时间，单位：秒。如果不设置该参数，结束时间为当前的查询时间
parameters.name: end_timestamp

parameters.help_en:
The type of rule hit by the protected object. By default, this parameter is not specified, which indicates that all rules are displayed.

blacklist: IP blacklist.

custom: Custom rule.

antiscan: Scan protection rule.

cc_system: HTTP flood mitigation rule.

region_block: Location blacklist
parameters.help_zh:
防护对象命中的规则类型。默认不设置该参数，表示显示全部规则。

blacklist: 表示命中IP黑名单。

custom：表示命中自定义规则。

antiscan: 表示命中扫描防护规则。

cc_system:  表示命中CC防护规则。

region_block: 表示区域封禁
parameters.name: rule_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to aggregate rule hits by protected object.

true (default): Aggregates rule hits by protected object. In this case, rule hits are counted based on individual rules only, and the Resource value in the response is empty.
false: Does not aggregate rule hits by protected object. In this case, rule hits are counted based on both protected objects and rules
parameters.help_zh:
规则命中次数是否聚合防护对象。

true（默认）：表示聚合防护对象的规则命中次数，即只按照单个防护规则命中情况统计次数，当前情况下发返回参数中Resource值为空。
false：表示不聚合防护对象的规则命中次数，即按照防护对象和防护规则命中情况统计次数
parameters.name: is_group_resource

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id
